messages:
ana: Thanks for coming to the security segment — quick follow-up thread for items we didn’t finish. Drop short questions and we’ll answer.

mike: First q — timeline for SOC2 and ISO? We got asked by a customer about Type 2 readiness.

sarah: SOC2 Type 1 evidence is collected, control docs in the compliance drive. Target for Type 2 attestation still Q3 end, pending evidence ingestion and remediation backlog.

pranav: To add, ISO is on the roadmap but behind SOC2; aiming for ISO 27001 certification in the next two quarters after SOC2 Type 2. No hard date yet.

devon: Any blockers preventing auditors from starting Type 2?

sarah: Biggest blockers: consistent log retention across dedicated/private deployments, and finalizing KMS BYOK rotation playbook. We can spin up interim evidence packages for high priority customers.

lucy: For VPC customers — are PrivateLink endpoints and audit-export available today? Customer asks about pushing audit logs into their SIEM.

pranav: Short answer: we expose audit logs via S3 export for Hosted & Dedicated; Private package supports syslog/Kinesis export to customer VPC. We need to document the exact path and ACLs — that’s in progress.

ana: (typo) ana: @pranav can you add the export docs link here?

pranav: Posted the draft: https://intranet.redwood/security/audit-exports (internal). Quick usage snippet below for customers pulling from S3: 

```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit-exports/ORG123/2026-03-20.gz ./logs.gz
zcat logs.gz | jq -c '.event'
```

mike: KMS BYOK question — can customers rotate keys themselves or do we require a joint rotation window?

security-bot: KMS key policy reminder: by default Redwood manages CMKs. BYOK customers have an option to bring CMK via AWS KMS external key ID or HSM import. See KB article.

pranav: We support customer-side rotation with a handshake window: export old key metadata, update key ARN in config, and we migrate cached keys for 24h. We’ll publish a runbook this week.

devon: How about HSM/BYOQ compliance evidence — do we have PoV for HSM-backed keys?

sarah: We’ve validated HSM integrations for the Private package; evidence artefacts (config screenshots, KMS policy diffs) are in the compliance repo under /evidence/hsm-pov-2026. Ops will produce a checklist for auditors.

lucy: Audit log retention length — customers ask about 1 year vs 3 years. What tiers support what?

pranav: Hosted default: 90 days. Dedicated: configurable up to 365 days. Private: customer-managed retention — can be 3+ years depending on storage. We can negotiate longer retention as an add-on for enterprise.

ana: ana: For customers asking about proof of continuous monitoring, can we show the Console dashboards as part of evidence?

security-bot: Console exports: token-level latency/cost dashboards, per-route traces, and alert history snapshots can be exported as PDFs/CSV for audit evidence. Use the export button on the dashboard.

mike: Any ETA on the runbook for key rotation and the doc for audit exports so PMs can share with customers?

pranav: Runbook draft by EOD Friday. Audit export docs will be expanded and uploaded to the compliance drive by Monday. I’ll ping here when done.

devon: Small ops ask — if we publish the migration window (24h), we need a safe fallback plan for failed rotations.

pranav: Fallback: we keep previous key active for 7 days for rollbacks; after successful migration we schedule an automated deprecate job. Details in runbook.

lucy: Can we get a short one-pager for sales — keys, retention, export formats, cert dates? Sales needs something <1 page to share.

ana: ana: Good ask — @sarah @pranav please produce a one-pager (bullet list) by Monday noon for the GTM folks.

sarah: Will do. I’ll draft and share a link.

ops-bot: Note: created task SECURITY-4321 to track runbook + docs + sales one-pager. Assignee: pranav. Due: 2026-03-30.

mike: Thanks — one tiny compliance detail — are we logging admin KMS actions to audit logs?

pranav: Yes, admin KMS events are logged. We redact sensitive fields but include action, timestamp, actor, and resource ARN. Export sample: 

```json
{"time":"2026-03-20T10:12:34Z","actor":"admin@example.com","action":"kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion","resource":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/abc123","result":"success"}
```

devon: Perfect. Last: any change to SLA or uptime targets while we roll out these features? Customers are worried about availability during migrations.

ana: ana: No change to SLA. We’ll communicate maintenance windows and rolling migrations; default fallbacks will route to compatible model variants if a region is affected.

mike: Great. I’ll send through a handful of customer-specific follow-ups after this thread.

pranav: Thanks all — I’ll update this thread with the runbook link and the one-pager when ready.

ana: Closing — appreciate the quick responses. :thumbsup:
